campaign: bounded isolated canonical durable-store fault campaign

interpretation.PASS: The canonical durable semantic failure/recovery boundary executed and reconciled in an isolated database.
interpretation.NOT_TESTED: A physical host or unavailable interface was not induced; the safe boundary was recorded and no effect was attempted.
interpretation.BLOCKED: The external provider was unavailable; the system recorded an honest block and no provider effect was attempted.
interpretation.external_effects: No real provider, browser, voice, network, host reboot, or live deployment effect is claimed by this artifact.
